what: An 8-bit drone synth in a dungeon: 16 algorithms from the old sound chips (NES, Game Boy, C64, Atari POKEY, AdLib, PC speaker), one knob per parameter (CURSE, HORDE, RUNE, ALCHEMY, an 8-bit echo, TORCH, BITS, AGE), WRATH as a live macro, a GROOVE of chiptune dungeon noises, a monster on every page.
author: swtdr34mz
